acceptance.heading: Acceptance of terms
acceptance.body: By using DerLg to discover and book travel experiences in Cambodia, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to them, please do not use the platform. This is placeholder content and does not constitute legal advice.

bookings.heading: Bookings
bookings.body: When you book a trip, hotel, transport, or guide through DerLg, you enter into an agreement with the provider of that service. We confirm availability and hold your selection for a limited time while you complete payment. Prices are shown in US dollars by default and may also be displayed in Khmer riel or Chinese yuan using indicative exchange rates.

payments.heading: Payments
payments.body: Payments are processed by licensed providers. We accept international cards through Stripe and local QR payments through Bakong and ABA. DerLg never stores your full card details. A booking is confirmed only once payment has been completed successfully.

cancellations.heading: Cancellations and refunds
cancellations.body: Our standard refund policy applies to most bookings: cancel at least 7 days before the start date for a 100% refund, between 1 and 7 days before for a 50% refund, and less than 24 hours before for no refund. Some providers may set their own terms, which are shown to you at the time of booking.

conduct.heading: Your responsibilities
conduct.body: You agree to provide accurate information, use the platform lawfully, and respect the providers, guides, and communities you interact with during your travels in Cambodia. You are responsible for ensuring you hold any visas, permits, or documents required for your trip.

liability.heading: Limitation of liability
liability.body: DerLg connects travelers with independent service providers and is not responsible for the acts or omissions of those providers. To the extent permitted by law, our liability for any booking is limited to the amount you paid for that booking. This is placeholder content and does not constitute legal advice.

changes.heading: Changes to these terms
changes.body: We may update these terms from time to time as the platform evolves. We will post the revised terms here and update the date shown above. Continuing to use DerLg after changes take effect means you accept the updated terms.

intro.heading: Introduction
intro.body: This Privacy Policy explains how DerLg collects, uses, and protects your personal information when you use our Cambodia travel booking platform. This is placeholder content and does not constitute legal advice.

dataCollected.heading: Information we collect
dataCollected.body: We collect the information you provide when you create a profile or make a booking, such as your name, email address, phone number, and travel preferences. We also collect technical data such as your device type, approximate location, and how you use the app.

dataUse.heading: How we use your information
dataUse.body: We use your information to confirm and manage your bookings, process payments, provide customer support in English, Chinese, and Khmer, personalize recommendations, and keep the platform secure. We do not sell your personal information.

dataSharing.heading: How we share your information
dataSharing.body: We share only the information needed to fulfil your booking with the relevant providers, such as hotels, transport operators, and tour guides. We also share data with payment processors (Stripe, Bakong, and ABA) to complete transactions. We may disclose information where required by Cambodian law.

dataRetention.heading: How long we keep your data
dataRetention.body: We keep your personal information for as long as your account is active and as needed to provide our services, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce our agreements. You can ask us to delete your account at any time from your profile.

rights.heading: Your rights
rights.body: You can access, correct, or delete your personal information through your profile settings or by contacting us. You can also choose which notifications you receive and manage your language and currency preferences at any time.

contact.heading: Contact us
contact.body: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your data, please contact our support team through the app. We aim to respond in English, Chinese, or Khmer within a reasonable time.

intro.heading: Introduction
intro.body: This Cookie Policy explains how DerLg uses cookies and similar technologies on our travel booking platform. This is placeholder content and does not constitute legal advice.

whatAreCookies.heading: What are cookies?
whatAreCookies.body: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website or use a web app. They help the platform remember your preferences and understand how the service is used.

typesUsed.heading: Types of cookies we use
typesUsed.body: We use two categories of cookies: essential cookies that are required for the platform to function, and analytics cookies that help us understand and improve how travelers use DerLg.

essential.heading: Essential cookies
essential.body: These cookies keep you signed in, remember your selected language and currency, and protect your booking session. The platform cannot work properly without them, so they cannot be turned off.

analytics.heading: Analytics cookies
analytics.body: These cookies collect anonymous information about how the platform is used, such as which trips are popular and where travelers run into difficulties. We use this to improve the booking experience.

managing.heading: Managing cookies
managing.body: You can control or delete cookies through your browser settings. Blocking essential cookies may prevent parts of DerLg, such as booking and payment, from working correctly.

booking.q: How do I book a trip?
booking.a: Browse trips, hotels, guides, or transportation, open an item, and use the booking button. You can also ask our AI concierge to book for you.

payment.a: We accept international cards via Stripe and local QR payments (Bakong/ABA) for Cambodia.

cancellation.q: How do I cancel a booking?
cancellation.a: Open the booking in My Trips and choose Cancel. The cancellation policy and any refund amount are shown before you confirm.

refund.a: Refunds are 100% if cancelled 7+ days before start, 50% if 1–7 days before, and 0% within 24 hours.

languages.a: The app and support are available in English, Chinese, and Khmer.

emergency.q: How do I get emergency help during a trip?
emergency.a: Bookings within 24 hours of start show an Emergency Alert button that shares your location with our support team.
